name: append a check symbol computed from the data
mechanism: compute a small value from the data by a fixed linear combination or modular sum and append it; the receiver recomputes and any mismatch reveals corruption, with the combination chosen so the most likely error patterns cannot leave it unchanged

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Parity' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Error detection and correction: simple/fast error detection technique
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Longitudinal redundancy check (LRC)':

requires: a combination rule shared by both sides (policy)
fails_when: error patterns in the combination's kernel pass undetected
